trigger: About to clean up or reset a repository
text: Never run a destructive git command (reset --hard, clean -f, push --force, branch -D, checkout .). Prefer reversible operations; if a destructive one is truly needed, stop and confirm first.

trigger: About to write a commit message
text: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject, where type is one of feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore, ci, build, perf, style.

trigger: About to create a branch before non-trivial work
text: Branch names follow Conventional Branch: type/kebab-description, where type is one of feature, bugfix, hotfix, chore, release, docs.

trigger: About to write a commit message or PR body
text: Never credit an AI assistant in published text: no Co-Authored-By for an assistant, no generated-with signature, no robot emoji.
